reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with Dr. Hylton! I had been seeing their ads for quite some time and was curious to give their services a try the next time my dog needed veterinary care. I’m glad I did! The team was very professional, friendly, and never pushy.
Thank you so much for the 5- review!  It means so much to us!

My senior dog absolutely loves this clinic and everyone in it ❤️

Over the past two years, we've had a number of urgent issues come up that needed attention, and the team has always been able to accommodate us and work through everything efficiently and with so much empathy.

My dog HATES needles, anything used for exams like stethoscopes, and pretty much anything that involves being poked or prodded. She gets very anxious, but the staff is always so patient and kind with her.

A few weeks ago, they were able to do bloodwork on her with absolutely no hassle for the first time in 12 years, without having to heavily sedate her for it. The lick mat was definitely a huge help, but so was the vet tech's knowledge and skill in doing the bloodwork sneakily. It was such a relief to see her get through it so calmly!

She's also had multiple assessments for different injuries, and the vets always know exactly how to get on her level and make her feel safe. They treat her so sweetly that she actually lets them examine her, even when it's something she really doesn't want to do.

Most recently, she had an ear hematoma treated at the clinic, which definitely isn't a pleasant experience. The vet and vet techs involved did an amazing job with the procedure and bandaging her head, all while being so gentle and compassionate with her. Any chance to avoid having my dog go under general anesthesia is a win for me, so this was great.

Despite all the uncomfortable procedures she's been through here, I STILL can't walk anywhere near the building without her dragging me towards the clinic because she wants to go inside, see everyone, get on the scale, and enjoy the treat bar 😂

I think that says everything you need to know about how wonderful this team is. They make what could be really stressful experiences so much easier for both of us, and I'm so grateful for the care they give her.

The photo attached is of her, still bandaged from her recent procedure, trying to lure me to the vet in the middle of the night when they were closed 😂❤️

TLDR: money-grubbing; felt-exploited.

I originally loved Juno! but their pricing isn’t transparent and they upsell (hard!). From emails, to the receptionist, to the tech., and vet—all of them asking to enroll for a yearly plan. Which, I was considering but not when the push is this hard.

Then, I noticed odd behaviour: I called and checked what a booster shot by a technician would cost (which is what their prev. Vet had told me to get).They said I’d be charged $65 (which was fine), and I booked the appointment.

Next thing: the appointment *automatically* got upgraded to a “vet appointment”—which was not needed nor asked for. I called them back and changed it back to the tech. appointment.

Then, I go in for a visit, and the tech. says that they’ll charge $65 for a consult. Why? I didn’t ask for it. The tech. then says “no it’s highly recommended and that it was necessary for my cat”—who really didn’t want to be there.

Irked, the moment the I said, “I’ll pay for the consult but just do the shot so I can take him home”, she instantly agreed, and the “necessary” consult was no longer necessary. She didn’t say “look, it’s important, I’ll be quick but we need to have this done”. It was all about getting more.

The appointment lasted for 10 minutes. Do I care that I spent $65 extra? Not at all—who cares about petty cash? If it takes $650 or $6500 for necessary well being, I’d do it.

But not this way. The whole ordeal felt like my love for my little ones was being exploited, and I won’t have that.
The staff here is absolutely incredible. The kindest people who go the extra mile to take care of your pup and you! Extremely grateful for them! The office is a treat for the eyes as well!
Thank you Lanyi for your 5 star review! It means so much to us!
Super friendly staff.  It was hard to schedule a technician visit, but these are growing pains as they are new.

We arrived at 5:30 on Saturday, walked in and said our pup we feel has some issue with breathing and has potentially something stuck in his throat, the receptionist told us they don’t have a dr on hand… then WHY ARE YOU OPEN ? Then I said you have a massive sign saying urgent care… and she said it’s by appointment which makes me think they don’t fully understand the meaning of urgent care.

She then walked into the hallway and waived off someone who definitely looked like a vet. I understand it was 30 minutes until closing on a Saturday but get a different job if you aren’t into what you’re doing and aren’t fine with the requirements.

We went to liberty location and had a great experience first time. This was the second visit.

She then recommended two other vet clinics for our issue which I googled in front of her and were closed.

Remove the urgent care sign from your store frontage and replace the girl at the front!

We just recently wanted to switch to a new vet, and one of our neighbors recommended Juno. Location that we visited a couple of days ago is their Liberty Village location on 1030 King West. We had the most wonderful experience all the way from booking with Cassandra by calling their general number all the way to the very last minute there, when my Jiji went crazy for their treats! My dog is very picky and never eats treats that are not from home but their treats really made her experience that much more pleasant. The front desk team is so sweet, and the medical team was just beyond kind and very professional! We had a great visit, and although we are not looking forward to coming back for anything health related, at least now we know that if we need to – we have a great clinic close to home that will be happy to take care of us in such an amazing way! Thank you guys for taking such good care of my Jiji from the bottom of my heart!
Thank you so very much for the 5 star review!  We truly appreciate it!

I don't get how a company can advertise "Upfront, transparent pricing" and yet fail to list their prices even for basic procedures like spaying/neutering.

"Surgery costs will vary depending on your pet’s sex, weight, health, and other factors" 🤦‍♂️🤦‍♂️🤦‍♂️

Calling your pricing upfront and transparent doesn't actually make it so.

My cat had a really wonderful visit with Dr. Jan Cao today! It’s so touching to see how patient the doctor and the technician were!! My cat used to be labeled as “fractious” in her previous vet. After Dr. Cao’s patience, my cat eventually  became cooperative today. 120/100 recommendation for cat parents looking for stress-free treatment approaches!

If I could give 10/5 stars I would! The staff, techs and doctors here are incredible. They truly make you feel taken care of, and you can tell Juno has thought of every step of the experience, including pricing. They will put a smile on your face even in your worries. I was not told or asked to leave a review- but my experience over multiple visits for different issues has been so positive, that Juno is now our forever vet. Thank you :)
Thank you, Juno vets for all the amazing services over the years. I’ve been to several locations and it’s always top-notch service.

I really appreciated that Juno was able to see us at the last minute on a day they were already fully booked. The doctor, Kiana Hylton, was patient with me, listened to all my crazy dog mom concerns and carefully explained all the treatment options and recommended an appropriate plan.

I will recommend this Juno location to anyone who will listen. They have the most kind and understanding people working on their team. I have had 3 fur babies and trust them with every one. I have been emotional and vulnerable and never feel judged or pressed for money. My heart is full knowing that not only my pets but I am in good hands. Please bring your pets here. You won't regret it. Ps. We love Dr.Megan!

I took my 9.5 month pup into see Dr. Zack as he had an eye issue & I was quite worried. From the moment we walked in, the staff couldn't have been more sweet & accommodating. Dr. Zack & his team were fantastic, you really felt they cared & provided wonderful support, guidance & solutions. Our pup is already on the mend! It's a relief to meet Dr. Zack as we've struggled to find a Vet we liked, search is over!

I visited Juno King West today to pick up my pet’s medication for ticks and fleas, and unfortunately, I had a very unpleasant experience with the reception staff at this location.

I usually visit the Summerhill location and have always had a much better experience there. Today, the medication I received was not what I expected. I was charged $48 for only a one-month medicine. I asked whether there were three-month or six-month chewable options available, as I had previously purchased a longer-lasting medication from another vet for around $100 that lasted the entire summer.

The receptionist was unwilling to check the price or see whether other options were available. Instead, she told me that I could go to another vet if I wanted to, but that this was the price they charged at their clinic.

I asked if she could check with the veterinarian or someone who manages the medication inventory to see whether there were other options available. I explained that I did not think it was reasonable to pay $48 every month, especially because my dog often vomits out tablets, making it difficult to administer medication every month.

Rather than trying to help me find a suitable option, she repeatedly told me that it was my fault for not ordering the medication correctly and that this was the only option available for pickup. When I asked if she was sure there were no other options, she said that she was not a technician or a doctor and that everyone was busy with appointments.

In the end, I had to pay for the medication because I needed to return to work. However, I left feeling very frustrated and disappointed. I feel that I was not given adequate information about the available options and was essentially charged for something I did not intend to purchase.

I hope Juno can review this experience and provide better customer service and clearer communication about medication options in the future.

Great vet! Super accommodating and supportive staff who know what they’re doing. Took my cat for two issues and they diagnosed him quickly with detailed explanations and preventative measures. Will be coming again for more vaccines for sure!! Discount for newcomers was great
Thank you Shawn so much for the 5 stars, we appreciate this!

All the staff are wonderful and took great care of our cat! They went above and beyond! We really appreciate the level of care that the staff clearly has in making sure that all pets are well taken care of. All of our concerns were thoroughly addressed. We especially appreciate how staff tried to connect with our cat to make her feel comfortable and build trust. We definitely recommend this clinic to anyone that wants the highest level of care for their pet! Shout out especially to Doctor Jan and Tanya!’

wow! what a place :) the staff is loving and welcoming.

there are treats for your furry friend and coffee, tea and fizzy water for you.

the waiting room is clean and nice and the places where you wait are very private and cozy.

the team is fast to get to you and patient while you are with them.

They are upfront about pricing, not pushy, and very professional. I am very happy.

My puppy is feeling a lot better.

And navigating the website, booking my appointment and paying were a breeze.

I also signed up for the 24/7 virtual help because now I actually feel a lot calmer knowing there is someone to talk to who isn't just google AI.

Excellent service. I would one thousand per cent recommend Juno.

Thank you!!!!
Awesome staff, really friendly and knowledgable!

My kitten had his very first visit to the vet for his exam and vaccinations, and I had an excellent experience. The veterinarians were incredibly knowledgeable, caring, and patient. They made sure my little one was comfortable throughout the entire exam, and he barely noticed what was happening because he was too busy enjoying the pets, attention, and treats they gave him during his shots.
Since he's still so young, I had lots of questions, and the team took the time to answer every single one in detail. They never made me feel rushed and were very thorough in explaining everything. I'm so grateful for the care and kindness they showed both me and my kitten. Highly recommend!
Such a lovely and kind team! They treated me and Honey with so much care and warmth at every appointment and went above and beyond helping us with our move abroad!!
Thank you so much for the 5 Stars Cassia, it means so much to us!

There aren't words to express how pleased I am with the level of customer service we received today but I'll try!

I was able to book my 2 cats in for the same week. I had to call to make an amendment to the appt. and the staff were so friendly and accommodating and made it so easy! The app is so aesthetically clean and user friendly and makes it easy to find everything you need, and differentiate between 2 pets (if you have more than one) instead of lumping all the info together and making you dig to find what you need.

On arrival, the front desk staff were very friendly and were able to put us in a room asap, even though we arrived 15 minutes early. Dr. Brian is a lovely man with a very easy going demeanour, and makes what could be a stressful appointment, stress-free. There was no judgement on the length of time since the last appt, no hard sells on vet food, no pushiness at all. Everything was clearly explained, prices were transparent so there's no sticker shock and they were able to update their shots at the same appt even though that's not what they were booked in for.

The customer service and quality of care confirmed it was the right decision to switch!

We have switched over to Juno vet because they have been so accommodating to our needs.

They were able to accommodate Cookie when we needed them the most.

Their prices are very transparent and they will walk you through the fees.

The location and atmosphere is very welcoming for fur parents and fur babies!
Thank you so much for the 5 Stars Max!  We truly appreciate it!

The private equity fingerprints are all over this place. On past visits, they’d walk us through an actual PowerPoint presentation of “options” — a thinly veiled upsell exercise that felt more like a sales pitch than a vet appointment. The vets skew young and, in our experience, lack the depth you’d find elsewhere in the area.
We’ve since moved to Pet Nation and haven’t looked back. The vets there are seasoned, straight with you, and seem to actually care about your animal rather than the invoice.
Vet visits are already stressful — your pet can’t tell you what’s wrong, and that makes you vulnerable. Juno knows this and leans into it. Pet Nation doesn’t. That difference matters.

Compared to all the other vets, I found that this vet team was exceptional, including follow-up care, service, transparency and accessing records, invoices, in a timely manner. The app is really helpful to have everything you need in one place. Greatly appreciate the whole team and Dr. Melissa White for a great outcome of dental surgery for my cat :)
Amazing care and customer service!

We took our recently rescued dog Kratos for his first appointment last weekend. Valeria and Melissa have been very kind, understanding and helpful to us. I couldn’t imagine a better visit they made sure Kratos was super comfortable as it was his first visit and they took their time answering all our questions in great detail. Everyone at Juno is very kind starting from the reception. Highly recommended!

I had a really positive experience at this clinic and felt compelled to leave a detailed review for anyone who may be looking for veterinary care, especially in a situation where timing and reassurance really matter.

I was able to book my appointment online on a Sunday, which in itself was incredibly convenient and relieving. Knowing that the clinic opens as early as 8 AM gave me a lot of comfort, especially since my dog wasn’t able to access regular veterinary care over the weekend unless it was through an emergency clinic. Being able to secure a timely appointment without added stress made a huge difference.

We saw Dr. Cao, and I truly appreciated her approach. She took a very thoughtful and balanced path, leaning conservative where appropriate while still prioritizing prevention and making sure we weren’t overlooking any higher-risk concerns. I left the appointment feeling very informed and confident in the plan moving forward. Nothing felt rushed at any point, which is something I value deeply when it comes to my pet’s care.

One standout aspect of the visit was the transparency. The estimate was reviewed directly with me in the room on a screen, and everything was explained clearly with Dr. Cao. There were no surprises and I felt fully involved in the decision-making process, which I really appreciated.

Dr. Cao was also wonderful with my dog. She was very gentle, friendly and patient. It was clear that she genuinely cares and the entire team created an environment that felt warm, welcoming and attentive from start to finish.

The clinic itself is extremely clean and feels very modern. I was even offered coffee, tea, and refreshments, which added a thoughtful touch. Overall, the space felt calm and organized. It didn’t have that typical stressful “vet clinic” energy, which made a noticeable difference.

I’ve been with my current vet for many years, as my dog is now 10 years old, but after this experience, I am genuinely considering transitioning her care to this clinic.

I highly recommend Juno Vet to anyone looking for professional, compassionate and transparent veterinary care.
Great experience for both me and my anxious dog. Would recommend 10/10.

Top-notch care and accurate treatment. They show you the estimate before proceeding, and as a member you can ask follow-up questions through their app — even the silly ones! They kept us informed every step of the way. Highly recommend!
Thank you for the 5-stars Jason!
Excellent care from the doctor and a very welcoming environment an experience. This is the third vet we have had in 10 months not changing now.

I had a great experience with this veterinary clinic. The staff were incredibly kind, patient, and professional throughout the entire visit. They treated my pet with so much care and attention, which made me feel calm and reassured.
Even in a slightly stressful situation, everything was handled smoothly and gently. The team took their time, explained everything clearly, and made sure both me and my pet felt comfortable.
I truly appreciate their kindness and dedication. You can tell they genuinely care about animals and their owners.
Highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a trustworthy and compassionate veterinary team!
Dr Helen and the team were so good with our boy. They kept him calm while making sure the tests were done with an extra dose of cuddles. We left the clinic feeling lighter and well cared for.

We recently made the decision to switch veterinary clinics. Today we found our people,  Dr Melissa & her team are amazing!  Charlie tends to be a nervous kitty & they managed to make the visit less stressful. Words cannot express how grateful I am to have found a veterinarian whose love for animals is evident in every action. She approached him with patience & kindness.

I love that we now have a clinic in our neighborhood, very convenient. This was my second visit to the clinic, with two cats this time. The staff are always so lovely and accommodating. I feel very comfortable taking my babies here.

Thanks for the great review! We’re happy to hear you had a good experience. If there’s anything we can do to make it a 5-star visit next time, we’d love to hear your thoughts. Looking forward to seeing you again!

Would definitely recommend.
I loved how empathetic Bianca at the front desk was with me, friendly with the doggo. I managed to get an appointment as my dog needed urgent attention and was bleeding.
The interiors are clean, well designed, with small thoughtful adds like treat jars for pups, a drinks freezer with pop, tea  /coffee and a comfortable space to sit.
Our vet Dr.Megan Eves was available, patient and got the job done. I appreciated that they were transparent about the $$ before any procedures and were patient with us about questions.
I love that they have an app and everything related to the visit is available to me almost immediately. And they have a chat service which l will try out in future.
Wonderful staff, very knowledgeable and dedicated!
Thank you so much for taking the time to give us 5 stars!
Thank you for the 5 stars Ben, we truly appreciate it!

I had such a great experience at Juno King West. We had an urgent issue with our senior cat who hasn’t seen a vet in a few years and they were so welcoming and obviously care about the animals they see. Communication was great and the clinic is upfront about pricing options and recommendations. We were very stressed and the staff here are kind and knowledgeable. The Juno app is also great with treatment/ medication records and live chat. Six stars for Dr. Jan and Sydney!
Such helpful staff. While I didn’t get my pet directly treated here as it was an ER case, the staff did help me contact the ER and closest ones near us to get our dog treated in time.
Affordable and great care and service. Friendly staff. Attentive and loving.

The team at Juno Vet is exceptionally friendly and communicative. They provided honest, thorough care for my cat this morning and treated him with the same love and attention I give at home. Felt confident he was in good hands the entire time!

I took my cat to Juno a few days ago as a new client and i was very pleased with our visit! Everyone from the receptionist to the Vet and vet tech were wonderful! We will bw coming back soon for blood work and its great that they are close to me as well 🙂 …
Thank you so much for your review, Cem!

I can't say enough nice things! Seriously.
Dr Melissa preformed surgery on our Boston Terrier for a large tumour on his left hip. The care he received from the whole team was incredible.

They text you to give updates and photos if your animal is receiving treatment.
Everyone is very kind and professional. Our dogs are 11 and we have never received such wonderful care, they really love on your animals and gain trust.

Go here! You aren't going to find a nicer team.

It was my first time using this vet and I was quite pleased with the service. Everyone was friendly and good at explaining things. Even made me a cup of tea on arrival. Very clean and modern facility.

dr. Jan Cao is an outstanding professional and person. the patience, kindness and attention was and will continue to be greatly appreciated by me and my best friend. they care to make sure my pup was taken care of and also a few treats for me (tea in my case). cost was reasonable compared to any other vet; but the value for the quality of service was outstanding. so happy to have found Juno. thank you Jan; and everyone at Juno on king!
Dr. Jan Cao and the technicians were really kind and patient for my appointment with my cat, definitely would recommend them

Thank you for such a warm welcome at Juno King West!
Having arrived from the UK last week, this was Dill's first visit to a Toronto vet . Dr Jan, Agatha and Kim could not have made us feel more welcome and cared for thank you.
Thank you so much for the wonderful review Catherine!

Friendly and informative staff!!
Great experience.

Took my cat here for a check up and the office is beautiful. The staff were amazing.
My cat wasn’t as stressed during the visit as she usually is at other vets
Thank you 🩷🫶🏻 …

I booked an appointment here due to my kittens sudden decline. Jessica specifically, called me before my appointment and asked me medical questions regarding my kitten Teddy and immediately recommended I rush her to the emergency vet. She searched up the nearest one for me to take her to and continued to give me amazing advice in a moment of panic as well as followed up with me after the fact to ask how Teddy was doing. Even though I didn’t have a chance to bring Teddy to Juno Vet, their staffing is amazing and very considerate. I couldn’t recommend this place more.
Thank you so much for the 5 stars!

Amazing experience with this whole team.  You can tell how much they love their jobs and care for the animals that come to see them.  They make for an easy and no stress visit to the vet for my boy Walter.  Keep up the great work! Would highly recommend them to anyone in the area looking for veterinary services
Great veterinary clinic! Dr. Megan Eves and the rest of the staff were very kind and helpful. The interior is also very well-maintained.

We were looking for a new veterinary clinic for our cat and decided to give Juno a try and it was absolutely amazing. When we left the clinic, my husband and I literally said “10/10” out loud at the same time.

From the very beginning, the team was incredibly kind and welcoming. They listened carefully to every question we had (even the silly ones) and made us feel completely at ease.

Dr. Garrett Schuilenberg and Elise were exceptionally detail-oriented, knowledgeable and truly caring. They took great care of our precious baby, and we felt confident and reassured the entire time.

The whole team was so lovely, affectionate and genuinely attentive.

Highly recommend, we’re definitely switching to Juno.

And for context, this review is coming from a very anxious cat/dog mom who rarely gives vets a 10/10 😁😅

I cannot recommend Juno Vet highly enough. Since we started coming here earlier this year, the team has consistently been warm and welcoming. One of the things I value most is their transparency; they provide clear, upfront costs for every check-up and treatment, so there are never any surprises.

I’m especially grateful to the entire staff for their incredible support during my pet’s relocation to India. They are exceptionally well-informed about the complex documentation required and guided me through every step with patience and expertise. Thank you so much for making a stressful process so much easier!
they were so so nice and helpful about luna’s stomach problems. stress free for us both. thanks!

The vets and the care they provide is great but the service is expensive! Specially any drugs dispensed at the clinic. I’ve noticed this on multiple occasions and during my last visit I was charged $50 for an eye drop that is available elsewhere for $12!!!

If you like to mark up the drugs so much then at least give me an option to buy it from somewhere else!
Thank you for your review, Sabrina!

As a first-time pet owner, I was very deliberate about choosing the right vet for my newly adopted cat. Juno Vet King West surpassed my expectations from start to finish. Their pre-appointment instructions were clear, check-in was quick, and the staff were warm and welcoming. We were brought to a private room early so my nervous cat could settle in, which made a huge difference. During the exam, the team used treats, explained everything thoroughly, and were upfront about pricing with full approval before proceeding. I couldn’t be happier to entrust my cat’s care to Juno Vet King West.
it was my first vet visit and the team at juno made it so smooth and seamless!
Thank you for your review - we appreciate it!

The staff are all very friendly and knowledgeable and the clinic is gorgeous, modern and spacious. Prices are fair and they are very upfront about any additional costs. I am happy to have finally found a vet clinic worth going back to!

I brought my rescue kitty here for her first visit. She is extremely nervous and I’m not able to fully handle her yet. The Juno team was so incredibly kind to her. Dr.Melissa helped me make a plan before hand to bring her in without stressing her out to much. My cat responded so well to them - they were able to trim her nails, cut out her mattes, see her teeth and give her a full inspection without her hissing or biting/scratching at all. They didn’t try to sell me on anything either. I would trust them with my cat any day!

I’ve been coming here for last 2 years for my cats. It’s  always a pleasure working with the team here. I especially appreciate that we can wait in the private examinations rooms. The feline stress diffuser in the room is a great touch as well to help my cats feel relaxed about the exam

The team is very upfront with pricing as well so never any surprises at the bill

I cannot even begin to explain how amazing this place is, Juno locations in general seem to be amazing, but this particular location had melted my heart. I brought my dog in to be dog in to be neutered today (Mr. Mittens),I genuinely love him like he is my child (gen z dog mom). I was so anxious for today worried something would happen to him, I brought a bunch of his toys,and they made his recovery space so incredibly cozy and nice, Taylor was so freaking sweet and reassured me, to the point where I felt so happy knowing the whole team really cares for your pets. i understand the prices are steep, but they are super comparable with all vets downtown, and their attention to your buddy is so worth it.  Dr. Garrett was so empathetic and compassion when calling to update about the surgery and post up instructions. (This is your sign to bring the team some sweet treats the day of your pet's operation, they work and were honestly so appreciative of it).
Thank you all :)
Also.... i saw a review mentioning to go to spadina animal hospital.... DO NOT GO THERE, they are absolutely horrible there and do not care about your pet at all but love their bottom line, please feel free to click on my profile and read my review of them.

Wonderful helpful staff. I slipped on some ice outside and the staff came out and help both my dog and I up, cleaned us up and did a thorough medical review of Billy. They were very informative, gave me options throughout the medical examination and provided a medical summary of the visit for my records. I would recommend Juno to any pet owner that is looking for an honest caring  veterinarian.

It was our first experience with Juno vet and it was amazing! Dr. Garrett Schuilenberg and the whole team were awesome  and attentive to all our details / complains about our puppy’s health (and we had a lot cause we are those anxious parents LOL).Moreover, not only we are in the process of resolving all our issues and concerns, Juno team is constantly in touch with us and all small requests are easily done within the app. We see that Rocky is feeling better and it’s all thanks to professionals who are working here. In general,it’s a huge pleasure just so visit June for a routine check up, because it’s very beautiful , calm and modern space which doesn’t give you that anxiety that usual doctor office could give. Thank you team 🧡see you soon xx

P. s. Rocky says hi and happy belated Halloween!

Love this place! Our cat was recently diagnosed as diabetic. As first-time parents of a diabetic pet, we were overwhelmed with the amount of info but the doctors and vet techs here made us feel at ease. They were patient and explained everything clearly, took the time to understand our questions and concerns and they go above and beyond in terms of service. I’m really happy with Juno and so is our cat!

Dr. Garrett went above and beyond before, during, and after Sunny’s spay. From the pre-op consults to the recovery check-ins, I felt fully supported every step of the way. I was genuinely comfortable leaving my pup in his hands — and for something as nerve-wracking as surgery, that peace of mind is everything. He truly cares about his patients and their humans. Sunny was in the best hands possible.

Also — the staff were wonderful, and the space itself is so beautiful. It looks more like a spa than a vet clinic. 🙂

Hi Kaitlin. Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We’re sorry to hear that your visit to Juno King West did not meet your expectations. We’ve sent you an email and would greatly appreciate the opportunity to discuss Boba’s care with you further, should you be willing.

- The Juno Veterinary King West Team
It was my first time visiting and the staff is nothing short of amazing! The booking process is easy to navigate. Everyone is pleasant and attentive. Even my cat enjoyed his visit!

Really impressed with Juno so far! We recently moved to Toronto and needed to find a new vet. Juno has exceeded my expectations in every way - from the friendly staff, transparency in pricing, access to medical records via their app, and overall ease of booking appointments. On top of this, Dr. Melissa White was very knowledgeable on Addisons disease, something my dog was diagnosed with a little over a year ago. 10/10 would recommend.
Hi Karina! Thank you so much for your review, we appreciate it!
Hi Josh, thank you so much for sharing your experience!

Had an amazing experience at Juno Vet! Took my cat in for a wellness check and everything went perfectly. The place feels super calm and welcoming, and the staff were all so kind and gentle.

The vet and staffs were awesome! Very professional and caring. Definitely one of the best vet visits we’ve had!

All around friendly staff and wonderful first visit as first time pet owners. The positive words from the staff meant a lot, and the doggies were so happy and comfortable in the care of all of the professionals. Definitely recommend this vet and Dr. Melissa White!
Lovely helpful and kind staff.
The care, installations and everything was so nice, felt the care for my baby girl
Comfortable place and chill vibe
great first initial experience, very modern and clean hospital with refreshments for the dogs and humans. felt my dog was getting the best treatment possible.

Hey Juno, thanks for your superb care and professionalism. A huge shout out to Taylor for preparing all the documents I need for international travel- if you need support for taking your pet abroad, this is the lady you need. Trust me, A* service. We embark on the long journey today and I am not worried one bit.
Thank you María!
The staff was very friendly and warm! I felt at ease knowing my cat is in the care of such friendly individuals. Highly recommend Juno!

Nothing but positive experiences here, both for myself and my pup! The staff and veterinarians are always friendly, knowledgeable, and treat us with genuine care. I recently visited this vet clinic with my dog, Truffle, and was thoroughly impressed with their service. The clinic feels more like a spa than a typical vet's office, which made the experience very pleasant. While waiting, I enjoyed a variety of drinks (hot, cold, and pop), and Truffle had unlimited treats both in the waiting area and in the exam room.

The exam rooms are incredibly relaxing, and as a pet owner, I appreciated having a comfortable seat. They also have a large monitor in the room to display quotes, which is much easier to read than a small computer screen. They provided both a low and high estimate, which was very helpful.

During the examination, the vet was extremely thorough. They asked about any concerns I had and then conducted a full body review of Truffle, including measuring all lumps and bumps, and checking his eyes, ears, nose, mouth, whole body, and paws. They even checked his anal glands, which I wasn't expecting.

Unlike other vets who just give a brief summary, they provided a detailed report with recommendations for supplements. Their prices are upfront with no surprise costs.

I initially joined their membership for $50 a year because it includes 24/7 vet tech support through their app. This service was invaluable when Truffle vomited twice in one night at 4 am, and I didn't know what to do.

Overall, this clinic offers the best veterinary care I've experienced, with detailed examinations, transparent pricing, and excellent support.
